## 3. Text formats (exact grammar; the samples below are generated by the app's own writer and re-read by its own parser)

General syntax of all `.txt` data: `$KEY: value` pairs; blocks are `$KEY: { ... }`; separators are commas or line breaks (trailing commas are fine); `//` starts a comment until end of line; numbers are decimal, `&1F` is hexadecimal (parsed only where a number is read); arrays are `[a, b]` or `B[a, b, c, d]` (bytes). Key names are case-insensitive when read, but write them **in capitals exactly as shown**. Unknown keys inside an ANO/frame are a **parse error** (the app refuses the paste and shows the error with the line).

### 3.1 `000.dac.txt` — animations

The file is `DAC_ACT_ { $ANO_0: {...}, $ANO_1: {...}, ... }`. One block per animation (ANO). An empty/absent ANO is `$ANO_n: { },`.

```
{{SAMPLE_ANO}}
```

- `$ANO_n` — `n` is the ANO number (0-based). `$PRIO` (optional) is the draw priority of this ANO. `$LNKS` (optional) = linked animations that spawn together with this one. `$MPTS` = the frames, in order, numbered `$MPT_0`, `$MPT_1`, … consecutively with no gaps.
- **Frame (`$MPT_i`)** fields (only write the ones you need; `$IMG` is **required**):
  - `$TIME: t` — duration in ticks (1..255). **Without `$TIME` the frame never advances** (it freezes; the ANO never finishes). Don't omit it unless a frozen frame is intended.
  - `$IMG: n` — sprite index = entry `$SPR_n` of `000.cnv.txt`. `-1` = no image.
  - `$MID: [x, y]` — sprite anchor offset in pixels.
  - `$WACTFLAG: n` — 16-bit state/behaviour flags of the frame. Known bits: **64 = keep the speed of the previous frame (instead of resetting to 0)**; 0x2000 (8192) and 0x8000 (32768) = frame/position synchronised with the parent (for linked animations). Other bits *(unknown)*: copy from existing frames.
  - `$SE: n` — sound id played at the start of the frame (see 5.6).
  - `$MOVE: { $XSPEED: v, $YSPEED: v, $XACCEL: v, $YACCEL: v }` — movement in **pixels per tick** (decimals allowed, e.g. `2.5`); any subset of the four. Positive X = forward (facing direction), positive Y = down. See 6.2.
  - `$HITS: { $HT_0: {$FLAG: f, $COORDS: [x, y, w, h]}, ... }` — "boxes"/actions of the frame (hitbox, hurtbox, spawn points, effects…); `x,y` relative to the character (x mirrored with facing); `w,h` size. See 5.2. **At most 10 per frame.**
  - `$OPT: { $FLAG: n, $DATA: B[d0, d1, d2, d3] }` — extra data, see 5.3 (damage, reaction code, interpolation).
  - `$RAZ: { $ROT: deg, $ALPHA: a, $XZOOM: pct, $YZOOM: pct }` — rotation (degrees), alpha (0 = opaque/255), zoom in percent (100 = normal).
- **Link (`$LINK_i`)**: `{$BX: x, $BY: y, $SYNC{SPAWN_POS: YES|NOT, XY: YES|NOT, MPT: YES|NOT}, $ANO: n}` — another ANO that spawns with this one at offset (BX, BY), following its parent. **Max 13 links per ANO; only one level** (a link's own links/hits/flags are ignored).

### 3.2 `000.bin.txt` — data blocks

`000.bin.txt` contains many `$HDAT_n:{ ... }` tables. The app reads and writes only these parts:

**Moves (HDAT 4).** One `$GOLPE_i:{...}` per move `i` (all values are plain integers, 16-bit):

```
{{SAMPLE_GOLPE}}
```

(Field meanings: table in 5.5.)

**Hit reactions (HDAT 14..33 = character reaction slots 0..19).** Each slot is a `$HDAT_(14+t)` block with an `$info` header and `$REACAO_DANO_t` rows `$FR_n`:

```
{{SAMPLE_REACTION}}
```

`$COL` = bytes per row (always 14), `$ROW` = number of rows, `$SZ` = `&` + 8 hex digits of `ROW*14`. If you change the number of rows you must update `$ROW` and `$SZ` (the app does this itself when it saves; if you hand-edit the file, do it too). Columns: see 5.4.

Everything else in `000.bin.txt` (other HDATs) must be **left exactly as it is**.

### 3.3 `000.cnv.txt` — sprite cuts

One line per sprite: the sprite sheet number `$src` (file `NNN.png`), the cut rectangle (x, y, w, h) **in physical pixels** (characters are stored at 2x; the game halves them when compiling):

```
{{SAMPLE_CNV}}
```

`$SPR_n` order = the image index `$IMG: n` used by frames. Appending a new `$SPR_n` at the end never shifts existing images. The rectangle must stay inside the PNG (the app warns "recorte fora").
